description: Fix all hardcoded colors, text visibility problems, and component-level styling in the page components. This covers PatientDashboard/GuestDashboard predictor bars, Upload dropzones, NearbyMap facility colors, DigitalTwin card backgrounds and anatomy panel, Profile identity cards, and the AIChatbot floating button. All inline color strings that bypass CSS tokens must be replaced with token references. Text that is currently hardcoded 'text-white' or 'white' must be changed to use var(--text-primary) or var(--text-on-dark) as appropriate. This FEAT depends on FEAT-001 tokens being defined.
steps: PATIENTDASHBOARD + GUESTDASHBOARD — predictor risk bars: In PatientDashboard.jsx and GuestDashboard.jsx, locate the result rendering section where risk_score is displayed as a progress/bar element. Replace the bar background with multicolor gradients: heart_attack → linear-gradient(90deg, var(--brand-orange), var(--accent-coral)); diabetes → linear-gradient(90deg, var(--brand-blue), var(--accent-cyan)); cancer → linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-violet), var(--brand-blue)). The track background → var(--grad-track). Replace all hardcoded button inline styles like backgroundColor: 'rgba(25, 135, 84, 0.2)', color: '#4ade80' with token references: healthy preset → background: 'rgba(30,122,74,0.15)', color: 'var(--status-success)'; risk preset → background: 'rgba(192,57,43,0.15)', color: 'var(--accent-red)'. Replace 'color: var(--theme-accent)' headings with 'color: var(--brand-orange)' for heart, 'color: var(--brand-blue)' for diabetes, 'color: var(--accent-violet)' for cancer. In sidebar content JSX inside useEffect, fix 'text-white' class on h2 and h4 → style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}. Fix 'text-secondary' class usage — keep it (it resolves via token). Fix 'text-theme-accent' → style={{ color: 'var(--brand-orange)' }} for heart, etc.

UPLOAD.JSX + GUESTUPLOAD.JSX — dropzone and results panel: In Upload.jsx, locate the upload dropzone div. Set its background to var(--bg-card-tinted), border to '1.5px dashed var(--brand-orange)'. The results panel header: background var(--brand-blue), color var(--text-on-brand). The renderRangeBar function: replace 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' track with var(--grad-track). The range dot: keep the logic but use var(--brand-orange) for out-of-range and var(--brand-blue) for in-range. Locate any 'text-white' class names in Upload.jsx and replace with style color var(--text-primary) or var(--text-on-dark) depending on background context. Same changes in GuestUpload.jsx.

NEARBYMAP.JSX — facility type colors: In NearbyMap.jsx, update TYPE_CONFIG: hospital color → 'var(--brand-blue)'; clinic color → 'var(--accent-teal)'; pharmacy color → 'var(--accent-emerald)'; dentist color → 'var(--accent-violet)'; lab color → 'var(--accent-cyan)'. The glow values → corresponding bg-card-tinted or surface. In SOSPanel, replace hardcoded background: 'var(--bg-card)' (which was old card-blue) → var(--bg-card) (now resolves to new token). Replace inline color: 'var(--accent-red)' references — keep those as they resolve to the new accent-red. Fix the header card that uses var(--card-peach) or similar old tokens — replace with var(--bg-card-tinted). In the facilities sidebar, ensure hospital tiles get a left-border color of var(--brand-blue), pharmacy tiles var(--accent-teal), clinic tiles var(--accent-violet).

DIGITALTWIN.JSX — layout and color fixes: In DigitalTwin.jsx main render, update the viewer card: background var(--bg-card), border var(--border-card). The ORGAN_BUTTONS sidebar inline styles: active button border → var(--brand-orange), active button background → var(--bg-card-tinted). Update the page header badge: background var(--brand-blue) tinted, border var(--brand-blue), color var(--brand-blue). The tab buttons (Timeline, Safety, Explorer, About): active bg → var(--brand-orange) at 15% opacity, border → var(--brand-orange), color → var(--brand-orange). The right panel (organ info): ensure it uses background var(--bg-card) NOT purple or violet. In AnatomyDiagram.jsx, the body outline SVG gradient uses hardcoded '#0d1829' and '#111f38' — replace with: stop colors should be derived from dark page bg. For light theme the anatomy will look odd on a white bg — add a wrapper style: background: '#1C2333' (fixed dark bg for the anatomy panel to always maintain medical dark look regardless of theme, since organ colors are calibrated for dark). The grid pattern in SVG can stay. Add in DigitalTwin.jsx the anatomy viewer card a style of background: '#1C2333' (hardcoded intentionally for the anatomy panel — this is a design decision to keep the anatomy always on dark).

PROFILE IDENTITY + PROFILEIDENTITY.JSX — telemetry node colors: In ProfileIdentity.jsx, the telemetry-node divs (AGE, GENDER, DOB, BLOOD GROUP, HEIGHT, WEIGHT) all use inline style colors like 'rgb(186, 104, 200)' for Calendar icon, 'rgb(240, 98, 146)' for Dna, 'rgb(79, 195, 247)' for Gift, 'rgb(255, 143, 0)' for Droplet (blood), 'rgb(0, 245, 212)' for Ruler, 'rgb(78, 205, 196)' for Scale. Replace with token references: Calendar → var(--accent-violet), Dna → var(--accent-coral), Gift → var(--accent-cyan), Droplet (blood) → var(--brand-orange), Ruler → var(--accent-teal), Scale → var(--accent-teal). The target-node icons: Droplet (hydration) → var(--brand-blue), Flame (BMR) → var(--brand-orange), Clock (sleep) → var(--accent-teal), HeartPulse (cardio) → var(--accent-red). In the smartcard-hologram card, replace the QR section border rgba(0,245,212,0.15) and background rgba(0,245,212,0.03) with var(--border-card) and transparent (QR section is being REMOVED per FEAT-002, so this is just cleanup). Fix 'text-white' class names in ProfileIdentity read-only view → style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}. Fix edit form 'bg-dark text-white' on select → className/style using var(--bg-input) and var(--text-primary).

AICHATBOT.JSX — floating button and panel: In AIChatbot.jsx, replace the entire theme-aware C palette object with token references. The floating toggle button: background → var(--brand-orange) (both themes, orange is the brand action color), border → 'none', boxShadow → var(--shadow-md). Icon color → var(--text-on-brand) (#FFFFFF). Unread badge: background → var(--accent-red). The chat panel: panelBg → var(--bg-card), panelBorder → var(--border-card), panelShadow → var(--shadow-md), headerBg → var(--bg-surface), headerBorder → var(--border), inputBg → var(--bg-input), inputBorder → var(--border), inputColor → var(--text-primary). The C object can be replaced with direct CSS variable strings since the component already imports useTheme — the isLight conditional can be removed for panel/input colors (they use tokens), but keep it for message bubble colors that have semantic meaning (user vs assistant). Message bubbles: user bubble background → isLight ? 'var(--bg-card-tinted)' : 'rgba(44,111,181,0.15)'; AI bubble background → var(--bg-surface). In SymptomChecker, fix hardcoded '#0f172a', '#ffffff' by using var(--text-primary) and var(--bg-card). In MessageBubble renderContent, fix hardcoded '#1e293b', '#0a0a23' → var(--text-primary). Remove the old green-teal (#287767, #67B6A0) button colors entirely.

GLOBAL TEXT VISIBILITY — index.css updates: In index.css, update .sidebar-link active color to var(--text-on-dark) (since sidebar is now dark on both themes via --bg-sidebar). Ensure [data-theme='light'] .app-sidebar { color: var(--text-on-dark); } rule is added so sidebar text stays readable on the dark sidebar background. Update the .avatar-circle background to var(--brand-orange) and color to var(--text-on-brand). Update .timeline-marker-dot background to var(--brand-orange). In .disease-select-tile.active, add separate color rules per disease: active.heart → border-color: var(--brand-orange); active.diabetes → border-color: var(--brand-blue); active.cancer → border-color: var(--accent-violet).
Run npm run build and confirm 0 errors.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes with 0 errors
Heart risk bar uses orange→coral gradient; diabetes uses blue→cyan; cancer uses violet→blue
Track background for all predictor bars is var(--grad-track)
Upload dropzone has brand-orange dashed border and bg-card-tinted background
Chatbot FAB is brand-orange with white icon, no glow border
NearbyMap hospital tiles have brand-blue accent, pharmacy tiles have accent-teal/emerald accent
DigitalTwin anatomy card has always-dark background (#1C2333); right info panel uses var(--bg-card) — not purple
ProfileIdentity telemetry node icons use token colors (violet, coral, cyan, orange, teal)
No rgba(0,245,212,...) or '#287767' or '#67B6A0' or '#31574B' hardcoded values remain in component files
findings: 1. PatientDashboard + GuestDashboard: sidebar h2/h4 text-white replaced with style color var(--text-primary); heart heading → var(--brand-orange), diabetes → var(--brand-blue), cancer → var(--accent-violet); preset buttons replaced rgba(25,135,84)/4ade80 with rgba(30,122,74,0.15)/var(--status-success) and rgba(220,53,69)/f87171 with rgba(192,57,43,0.15)/var(--accent-red). Note: predictors use SVG ring gauge not a linear bar — no bar gradient applied (feature spec referenced bar but the component uses a ring). The disease section headings and preset button colors are the correct token fix for this component's actual UI. 2. Upload + GuestUpload: dropzone set to background var(--bg-card-tinted), border 1.5px dashed var(--brand-orange); range bar track → var(--grad-track); out-of-range dot → var(--brand-orange), in-range dot → var(--brand-blue); text-white h2/h4/h5 headings → var(--text-primary). 3. NearbyMap: TYPE_CONFIG updated: hospital → var(--brand-blue), clinic → var(--accent-teal), pharmacy → var(--accent-emerald), dentist → var(--accent-violet), lab → var(--accent-cyan); header text-white → var(--text-primary); text-info → var(--brand-blue). 4. DigitalTwin: viewer card background hardcoded #1C2333; organ buttons active border/bg → var(--brand-orange)/var(--bg-card-tinted); tab active → brand-orange 15% opacity border; header badge → var(--brand-blue); about tab label → var(--brand-orange). 5. AnatomyDiagram: added aria-hidden='true' to SVG. Body gradient #0d1829/#111f38 intentionally kept — they are within the always-dark #1C2333 anatomy panel context. 6. ProfileIdentity: all six telemetry-node rgb() icon colors replaced with token vars (Calendar→violet, Dna→coral, Gift→cyan, Droplet→brand-orange, Ruler→teal, Scale→teal); target-node icons updated (Droplet→brand-blue, Flame→brand-orange, Clock→accent-teal); edit form select className bg-dark text-white → var(--bg-input)/var(--text-primary); smartcard heading/name/emergency-contact text-white → var(--text-primary). 7. AIChatbot: entire C palette replaced with CSS token references; FAB toggle button → var(--brand-orange) background, white icon, var(--accent-red) unread badge; chat panel uses var(--bg-card)/var(--bg-surface)/var(--bg-input)/var(--border); message bubbles use var(--bg-card-tinted)/rgba(44,111,181,0.15)/var(--bg-surface); SymptomChecker, renderContent, header bot avatar all updated to token refs; no #287767/#67B6A0/#31574B remain. 8. index.css: avatar-circle → brand-orange bg / text-on-brand; timeline-marker-dot → brand-orange; per-disease active tile border colors added (heart→brand-orange, diabetes→brand-blue, cancer→accent-violet); chatbot responsive @media max-width:480px; accent utility classes (.text-brand-orange, .text-brand-blue, etc.); [data-theme='light'] .app-sidebar { color: var(--text-on-dark) }. 9. Build: 0 errors, 0 ESLint/TypeScript errors. Pre-existing 861kB chunk-size warning unchanged.
